items.title: Heatbit's New Water Heater Miner Turns Hot Showers Into Bitcoin

Heatbit's new $899 Bitwater device swaps an ordinary heating element for 20 mining chips, turning electricity used for hot showers into potential bitcoin earnings. items.title: Electrum Wallet Attack Hid Bitcoin Theft Behind a Fee Increase
items.summary: A malicious bitcoin wallet server could quietly swap a legitimate payment for a thief's transaction, then wait for its owner to approve the theft. items.title: Bitcoin's wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
items.summary: Borrowing against bitcoin and earning income to build their BTC holdings are becoming priorities for long-term investors, Xapo Bank CEO Seamus Rocca told CoinDesk.

items.title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
items.summary: Developers will now backport fixes and cut releases immediately for flaws flagged as "easily discoverable," abandoning long embargoes for bugs an attacker can surface with a single AI prompt.

items.summary: Investors this week were buying bitcoin ETFs but that all changed on Thursday. This post Bitcoin ETFs Lose Over $635M In One Day Following Oil Price Spike first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Bleed $636 Million as October Turns Red Again
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $635.6 million on Thursday, their biggest outflow of the month, pushing October flows back to a loss of about $176 million as Ethereum and Solana funds also bled.
